library.name: MQSpaceData
library.author: abcdaaaaaaaaa
library.sentence: The first and only Arduino library where MQ Sensors combine with Data Science
library.paragraph: This library supports a wide range of MQ gas sensors (MQ-2, MQ-3, MQ-4, MQ-5, MQ-6, MQ-7, MQ-8, MQ-9, MQ131, MQ-131_LOW, MQ-135, MQ-136, MQ-137, MQ-138, MQ-214, MQ-216, MQ303A, MQ303B, MQ306A, MQ307A, MQ309A). Instead of sensor-specific calibration, it uses gas-specific reference calibrations, enabling more accurate ppm calculations. Key features include temperature and humidity compensation using a correction coefficient model; calibration and analysis support for unsupported MQ models; enhanced JavaScript-based tools for hardware-free testing and computation; 3D ppm concentration graph simulation; and a Python-based 4D ppm curve prediction platform featuring 76 different models for advanced data analysis, ranging from classical regression methods, multivariable regression models, curve fitting and spline-based approaches, time series analysis, state-space and Kalman filtering methods, to machine learning algorithms, ensemble learning methods and artificial neural networks.
